items.title: Laurena Diggs and Carrie Boote Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: The name 'Dick Allen' is mentioned by the [INTERVIEWER] identifying himself: 'And I'm Dick Allen again.' The interviewee does not mention Dick Allen in the provided text.

ctx.x: And we're going to start another interview. So Ms. Diggs, let me get your name again while the tape machine is on. Lorena Diggs. L-A-U-R-E-N-A. And your name again? Carrie Boop. And I'm Dick Allen again. And we just finished doing an interview with Archie Martin. And we're still up here at 1926 Harmony Street, September the 3rd, 1960. Alright, so... I have a whole lot of questions to ask you all about. Ms. Diggs, do you mind telling me about that song, Over the Garden Wall? Do you remember we were talking about…

Yeah. Well, I'll tell you, it's been quite a while. Because I heard the last of it was in, when was I in Milwaukee, in 40-something. That was the last, but that was when during the Spanish-American War. Over the Golden Wall, the sweetest girl of all. I'll never forget the night we met over the Golden Wall. That's what that was. Goodbye, dear one, till we meet again over the Golden Wall. I'll never forget the night we met over the Golden Wall. Now that was sang in the Spanish-American War. Mm-hmm.
